method: As-of original dated company release/SEC 8-K prepared facts coded across frozen 6 winner-loser 2024-25 AH pairs
limitations: Retrospective known outcomes, 6 different-industry/multiple-month pairs, not issuer/sector-matched
Release versus EXPECTED surprise unknown for most sources
No historical dated analyst forward EPS revision history, do not treat current updated estimates as event-time
Release timestamp for issuer pages sometimes no 4pm clock; day/session inferred from initial frozen roster, contemporaneous issuer sources
Management guidance proxy already failed as independent binary hypothesis
D4 returns are underlying-stock simulations, not actual call option premiums or execution

events.outlookDetail: Q3 FY2025 revenue $7.2B +/- $0.5B; nonGAAP EPS $2.35 +/-0.20; FY management guidance revision not established
events.narrative: Revenue +7% and adjusted EPS +14%; CFO explicitly said no significant changes in customer demand despite dynamic economic and trade conditions. Export/trade policy is a disclosed risk, but no contemporaneous earnings release-specific quantified new restriction. Q3 outlook $7.2B midpoint. Coding conservatively: broad macro/trade uncertainty is not by itself a newly quantified material constraint within this specific release; export controls are mentioned in cautions, prepared remarks would require separate dated sourcing.
